description: Symbol Chart is a versatile and powerful Power BI visual for creating infographic‑style charts that connect data to real‑world objects through meaningful symbols and icons. Choose from a wide range of pre‑installed symbols or import your own to build rich, expressive infographic visuals. Combined with extensive formatting and layout options, Symbol Chart offers a high degree of flexibility and customization. Horizontal or vertical multiples make comparisons easy and allow you to build and maintain multiple charts efficiently. A color legend further enhances interpretability and supports clear infographic storytelling. Key features: Over 80 pre‑defined symbols plus support for custom symbols Create infographic‑style charts with real‑world icons Flexible layout powered by an innovative layout model Extensive formatting options Use as a single chart or with categories/multiples Interactive selection of multiples or categories Vertical and horizontal alignment of charts within the layout area Symbol rotation in 90° steps Adjustable chart flow direction
keywords: Infographic symbol chart with custom icons and flexible layouts for Power BI
